subject: Mutual Action Plan & discount request - FinLytics evaluation
messages:

Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@finlytics.com>
Date: 2026-03-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan & discount request

Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at FinLytics was impressed with the latency numbers and the dedicated routing ideas. We’d like to put together a short MAP so we can run an evaluation with a goal of a production pilot in Q2. High level ask:

- 6-week evaluation starting with 10k monthly calls, then ramp to 100k/month in pilot.
- We need a committed pricing path for pilot->production.
- FinLytics is asking if Redwood can offer a 20% discount on hosted API list pricing conditional on a 12-month committed spend (we can provide a predictable monthly commit).

Attached is our draft MAP and evaluation checklist (FinLytics-MAP-v1.pdf). Can you confirm whether 20% is doable as a standard offer or if we need to route for approvals? If approvals are required, please let us know the expected timeline — we need to align procurement and legal on our side.

Also looping Samir (ops) — he’ll run the eval.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Head of Product
FinLytics

Attachments: FinLytics-MAP-v1.pdf
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com

Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@finlytics.com>
Date: 2026-03-08T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & discount request

Hi Olivia — great to meet you and thanks for the MAP. Very excited to partner on a short, targeted evaluation.

Quick summary of how we generally handle these:
- We can offer tiered commercial proposals tied to commit length and volume. Typical tiers are 10% (6-month commit), 20% (12-month commit with $X monthly minimum), and anything >20% requires exec sign-off.
- For a 12-month committed plan we’ll need a signed SOW and a billing schedule.

I’ve attached our internal pricing grid for transparency. For me to confirm the 20% formally I’ll need to route the MAP + proposed commit to finance for approval — should be a short chain but I’ll flag it as time-sensitive.

Proposed next steps:
1) We’ll update your MAP with Redwood milestones and a short SOW draft (I’ll attach).
2) If you confirm the 12-month commit band I’ll route for approval today and aim to get a formal offer by EOD Friday.
3) Pilot kick-off once SOW signed.

Does that timeline work for FinLytics? If so, confirm the monthly commit floor you’d be comfortable with and I’ll start the approvals loop.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Neha — forwarding the MAP from FinLytics. They’re asking for 20% on hosted API pricing in exchange for a 12-month committed spend (they expect pilot->production ramp to ~100k calls/month).

Key deal points:
- Account: FinLytics (SaaS analytics)
- Proposed commitment: 12 months, target $48k/month (example floor — exact to be confirmed by Olivia)
- Customer requests 20% off list for the committed term.
- Attachments: FinLytics-MAP-v1.pdf, our pricing grid, a draft SOW.

Ask: can you approve 20% at the commercial level or do we need VP/CFO sign-off? I expect legal to be on a short SOW; we want to get back to them with clear acceptance/conditions.

Thanks — this is time sensitive; they want a finalized offer by Friday.

—Marissa
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-03-09T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Mutual Action Plan & discount request (FinLytics) — approval request

Marissa — thanks for the context and the attachments. Quick read: FinLytics looks like a strong-fit PLG-adjacent account; the ramp/usage profile is reasonable.

Guidance from me: we can approve up to 15% within standard AE discount authority for a 12-month commit. Anything at or above 20% will need VP-level approval (vivek) and finance (laura) to confirm margin impact. Please escalate to Vivek and loop Finance.

Also note: if the customer can convert some of the spend to a Reserved/Dedicated commitment (vs hosted), that would materially change the economics and might give us more flexibility on discounting. Helpful to capture in the MAP.

Forwarding to Vivek to weigh in.

-Neha
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-03-10T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinLytics - MAP discount escalation

Thanks Neha — Marissa, I reviewed the MAP and the proposed commit. I’m comfortable supporting a 20% discount for a 12-month committed hosted plan on these conditions:

- The customer signs the SOW with a clearly defined monthly committed minimum (please confirm the dollar floor).
- Payment terms are pre-negotiated (monthly or quarterly invoicing, no more than Net 45).
- We include a step-down clause if they fail to meet the ramp milestones (pro-rated true-up/termination protections).

However, any discount above 20% requires CEO/CFO sign-off. Looping in Laura for finance approval on the 20% (margin impact, revenue recognition). Laura — can you confirm finance is ok with 20% under those conditions?

If finance signs off, Marissa proceed to finalize the offer and send to FinLytics.

-Vivek
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-03-11T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinLytics - MAP discount escalation

Thanks Vivek — I reviewed the numbers and the proposed structure. Finance will approve a 20% discount on the hosted API list price for a 12-month committed revenue stream provided: 

1) The SOW includes the monthly minimum (no catch-up credits).
2) We capture billing cadence and a non-refundable commitment for the first two months to reduce churn risk.
3) The step-down clause is in place with at least 30 days notice for remediation.

I do not approve discounts >20% without explicit CEO sign-off (we should only entertain deeper concessions if they move to Dedicated/Reserved capacity or front-load ARR).

I’ll attach the SOW checklist (see SOW-FinLytics-draft.docx) — Marissa, once you update the SOW with the billing schedule and monthly minimum send back to finance and I’ll sign off in the system.

- Laura Bennett
CFO, Redwood Inference
